name: @aether/service-pricing
description: Bitemporal price lists with unlimited-dimension market matrices (point-in-time price reconstruction at any T), promotion engine with pack-defined stacking rules (stackable/exclusive, cap-per-order), bundles, B2B quantity tiers, and ML-price guardrails (floor/ceiling/max-daily-move as constitutional config — algorithmic prices are clamped, never trusted). Every price, promo, tier, and guardrail is pack data.
